title: Resume Generator Application Config Schema
description: JSON schema for the application configuration

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If null, logging will be done to the console.

output_dir.description: Directory where generated resumes will be saved

output_filename.description: Template for naming generated resume files. Use placeholders like {author} and {date}.

overwrite_existing.description: Whether to overwrite existing files in the output directory

template_dir.description: Directory where resume templates are stored

template_filename.description: Filename of the resume template to use

document_language.description: Language of the generated document, e.g., 'en-US'

document_keywords.description: Keywords associated with the generated document
